requirements.details: For the following 40 listed programmes, the call permits consideration of relevant A-level subjects for second-year entry: Bachelor of Science; Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Sciences (Honours); Bachelor of Science in Biological Sciences; Bachelor of Science in Chemistry (Honours); Bachelor of Science in Computer Network Engineering; Bachelor of Science in Computer Science; Bachelor of Science in Electronics; Bachelor of Early Childhood Development; Bachelor of Science in Family Sciences; Bachelor of Science in Food and Nutrition; Bachelor of Science in Geography; Bachelor of Science in Geology; Bachelor of Science in Information Systems; Bachelor of Science in Mathematics; Bachelor of Science in Nuclear Science and Technology; Bachelor of Science in Physics; Bachelor of Science in Statistics; Bachelor of Arts in Development Economics; Bachelor of Arts in Economics; Bachelor of Arts (Public Administration); Bachelor of Arts (Political Science); Bachelor of Arts in Psychology; Bachelor of Arts in Sociology; Bachelor of Social Science; Bachelor of Social Science (Gender Studies); Bachelor of Social Science (Social Work); Bachelor of Arts in Social and Economic History; Bachelor of Arts - Humanities; Bachelor of Social Science in Population Studies; Bachelor of Arts in Literary and Cultural Studies; Bachelor of Arts in Library and Information Science; Bachelor of Arts in Linguistics and Language Studies; Bachelor of Arts - Theology; Bachelor of Arts in Drama; Bachelor of Arts in Fine Arts; Bachelor of Arts in Fashion and Design; Bachelor of Arts in Communication and Cultural Studies; Bachelor of Arts Media for Development; Bachelor of Arts in Creative Arts; Bachelor of Arts in Film Production. Assessment is not a guaranteed place or automatic credit award. Fine Arts specifies relevant art subjects; Population Studies gives Sociology, Psychology and Economics as examples. Music has its own passed-Music rule. Law Enforcement and International Relations are not included in this shared advanced-entry list. Any programme-specific aggregate ambiguity remains separate.
